• Liderar a implementação e evolução da plataforma de observabilidade, consolidando logs, métricas e traces.

• Definir, padronizar e manter painéis e alertas para serviços críticos da organização.

• Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade (SLIs, SLOs), orientando decisões técnicas com base em dados.

• Automatizar respostas a alertas e reduzir o toil por meio de scripts e integrações entre ferramentas.

• Atuar na gestão de incidentes: triagem, coordenação de resolução, documentação e melhoria contínua.

• Apoiar squads de produto e infraestrutura na análise de performance e comportamento dos sistemas.

• Desenvolver e disseminar boas práticas de observabilidade nos ciclos de desenvolvimento e operações.

• Conduzir treinamentos técnicos sobre métricas, rastreamento e diagnóstico de aplicações.

• Evoluir continuamente o processo de detecção proativa e resposta rápida a falhas.

• Apoiar auditorias e relatórios técnicos com dados precisos de disponibilidade e incidentes.


Principais conhecimentos:

• Automação de processos operacionais e scripts para coleta e análise de dados (Python, Shell, PowerShell).

• Criação e manutenção de documentação operacional (runbooks, playbooks, checklists).

• Colaboração com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e produto para antecipação de riscos e padronização de visibilidade.


Perfil acadêmico e habilidades:

• Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência sólida e comprovada como SRE, Observability Engineer ou DevOps com foco em monitoramento.

• Domínio técnico de Zabbix, Elastic Stack e Dynatrace em ambientes de missão crítica.

• Forte entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e métricas operacionais.

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:

You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling

  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues

  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office .

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure:

  • Compute: Proficiency in managing and optimizing virtual machines, containers, and serverless computing on GCP (e.g., Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Functions).
  • Networking: In-depth knowledge of VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity solutions (e.g., Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN).
  • Storage: Expertise in various storage solutions, including Cloud Storage, Persistent Disks, Filestore, and database services like Cloud SQL, Bigtable, and Firestore.

Security:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Strong understanding of IAM roles, policies, and best practices for securing cloud resources.
  • Data Protection: Experience with encryption, key management (e.g., Cloud KMS), and data loss prevention (DLP) services.
  • Compliance: Familiarity with compliance standards and implementing security controls to meet regulatory requirements.
  • HashiCorp Vault: Proficiency in using HashiCorp Vault for secrets management, encryption, and access control.

Automation and Scripting:

  • Scripting Languages: Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell for automating tasks and managing cloud resources.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, and Ansible for provisioning and managing infrastructure.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Enterprise: Expertise in using Terraform Enterprise for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and governance.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Cloud Build).

DevOps and Monitoring:

  • Containerization: Expertise in containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).
  • Monitoring and Logging: Proficiency in monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana) to ensure the health and performance of cloud environments.
  • Incident Management: Experience with incident response and management tools (e.g., PagerDuty, Opsgenie) to handle and resolve issues promptly.

Data and Analytics:

  • Big Data: Knowledge of big data processing and analytics services (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc) for handling large-scale data workloads.
  • Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning services (e.g., AI Platform, AutoML) and integrating ML models into cloud applications.
  • Data Integration: Experience with data integration and ETL tools (e.g., Cloud Data Fusion, Apache Airflow) for building data pipelines.

Cloud Architecture:

  • Design Patterns: Understanding of cloud-native design patterns and best practices for building scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions.
  • Microservices: Experience with microservices architecture and related technologies (e.g., Istio, Envoy) for building and managing distributed applications.
  • API Management: Proficiency in API management tools (e.g., Apigee) for designing, securing, and monitoring APIs.

title: Account Executive
description:

About Us


Publicity For Good (PFG) is a Nashville-based public relations company that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands around the world.


We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.


At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth.


We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role

The Account Executive is responsible for managing the success of client PR campaigns by developing media strategies, conducting targeted outreach, and maintaining regular communication with both clients and media contacts. This role ensures client visibility across national, regional, podcast, radio, and TV platforms, while also contributing to broader brand awareness and engagement. Account Executives are key relationship builders and storytellers who drive results by connecting the right narrative to the right outlet.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and execute strategic PR plans tailored to each client
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients
  • Build, grow, and create new client relationships
  • Conduct media research and Build and update targeted media lists
  • Secure, filter, and respond to media opportunities
  • Schedule and coordinate media interviews, ensuring all logistics are handled
  • Follow up with media contacts to confirm placements and coverage timelines
  • Monitor coverage through Google Alerts and track mentions or product features
  • Facilitate writing projects with team in alignment with client goals and deliverables
  • Monitor news trends and identify timely angles for client exposure
  • Provide daily (Monday–Friday) client updates and maintain consistent communication
  • Prepare and send biweekly and monthly reports and lookbooks
  • Maintain updated media trackers to record media coverage and interview status


Results


  • Meet or exceed the expected number of interviews or media features
  • Clients receive timely and proactive communication on campaign progress
  • Media placements align with client goals, increase brand visibility, and credibility
  • Clients recognize value from their engagement with Publicity For Good
  • Accurate and updated documentation of all PR activities and client deliverables


Requirements


  • 40 hours plus per week to meet client needs
  • Proven experience or education in public relations or a related communications field
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities
  • Proficient in Google Suite, Gmail, and media monitoring tools
  • Creative and strategic thinker with a proactive mindset
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first team environment
  • Personable and professional in client and media interactions
  • Able to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously
  • High level of self-accountability and commitment to delivering results


Remuneration & Rewards


  • Access to internal and external learning opportunities
  • Ongoing performance reviews and career development guidance
  • Clear advancement plan based on both role progression and financial growth
  • Access to a curated library of on-demand professional development content


The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.

description:

This role requires a professional with a strong background in dermatology or rheumatology, extensive experience supporting clinical trials, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will serve as a key scientific resource, building relationships with stakeholders, facilitating clinical trial activities, and generating insights to inform strategy and improve patient outcomes.

Clinical Trial Support :


  • Collaborate with clinical trial teams to support trial enrollment efforts, including identifying suitable patients and optimizing recruitment strategies.
  • Engage with clinical trial sites and investigators to ensure smooth trial operations and alignment with study objectives.
  • Provide education and training to clinical sites on study protocols and therapeutic areas.


Insight Generation and Framework Creation :


  • Gather and synthesize insights from healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients, and other stakeholders to identify referral patterns, challenges, and opportunities for trial enrollment.
  • Develop frameworks to streamline patient identification and referral pathways.


Stakeholder Engagement :


  • Build and maintain relationships with HCPs, clinical trial investigators, and other key opinion leaders (KOLs) in dermatology.
  • Act as a liaison between clinical sites, investigators, and internal teams to ensure effective communication and support.


Cross-Border Collaboration :


  • Work across national borders to address global clinical trial needs and ensure compliance with international regulations and cultural nuances.
  • Collaborate with global teams to align on strategies and share best practices.


Travel Requirements :


  • Travel extensively to meet with stakeholders, support trial sites, and attend relevant conferences and events.


Independent Work :


  • Operate autonomously to manage responsibilities, meet deadlines, and drive projects forward while maintaining alignment with organizational goals.


Qualifications and Experience:


  • A minimum of 3 years of experience as a Medical Science Liaison or in a similar role.
  • Strong background in dermatology or rheumatology, with experience engaging with dermatologist-focused clinical trial sites and investigators.
  • Proven track record of supporting clinical trial enrollment, patient identification, and site engagement.
  • Experience generating insights and developing frameworks to address complex challenges in clinical trial operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify patient referral patterns and address barriers to patient participation.
  • Willingness to travel extensively, including international travel.
  • Experience working in cross-border settings and collaborating with global teams.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently.


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Advanced degree (e.g., PharmD, PhD, MD) in a relevant field is highly desirable.
  • Experience with insight generation in the context of dermatology or rheumatology clinical trials.
  • Knowledge of global regulatory environments and best practices in clinical trial management.

title: Video copywriter and editor (Facebook ads)
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months
  • Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
  • Have a documented system another creator could follow.
  • Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.
What you will do
  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).
Who you are
  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.


Core values

Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.

Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.

Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.


Offer

Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

  • Your portfolio (required if you have it)
  • A short note on your AI + editing workflow
  • 2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Product Owner– AI-Powered Platform
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Product Owner of an AI-Powered SaaS Solution, you will lead the delivery and integration of AI and automation capabilities across a suite of SaaS products. This role bridges product strategy with execution—translating business needs into technical requirements and ensuring that AI-driven features deliver measurable value. The ideal candidate will coordinate closely with data science, engineering, and product teams to build scalable, high-impact AI solutions that enhance user experience and business performance.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Drive the execution and delivery of AI-powered features, use cases, and platform capabilities across multiple SaaS products;
  • Translate business and product team requirements into actionable technical stories and sprint deliverables for data science and engineering teams;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional squads to embed AI and automation into existing product workflows (e.g., recruiting, onboarding, performance, learning, analytics, and public safety);
  • Define and manage the product backlog for AI feature delivery, striking a balance between immediate priorities and long-term platform scalability;
  • Develop execution roadmaps, milestones, and release plans for model training, integration, and deployment across multiple product lines;
  • Track key performance indicators (velocity, cycle time, release quality, adoption metrics) to ensure continuous improvement in delivery efficiency;
  • Oversee post-deployment validation, ensuring model accuracy, reliability, and user experience alignment.


Essential Skills

  • Proven experience managing AI/ML-driven product initiatives within SaaS environments;
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies and end-to-end product lifecycle management;
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business terms;
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to define success metrics and measure adoption and performance;
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams (engineering, data science, product, and UX).


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with machine learning model lifecycle management—from concept to deployment;
  • Familiarity with AI integration in enterprise SaaS systems, including automation, natural language processing (NLP), and predictive analytics;
  • Understanding of MLOps, model monitoring, and continuous improvement practices;
  • Ability to balance innovation with scalability and compliance requirements.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Engenheiro mecânico
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Sobre o papel:


Atuação como Engenheiro(a) Mecânico(a) na área de manutenção de equipamentos dinâmicos, com foco em garantir a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e desempenho dos ativos em ambiente offshore, prestando suporte técnico às equipes operacionais e contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos de manutenção.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Atuar na manutenção de equipamentos dinâmicos como compressores, motores, bombas e sopradores;
  • Realizar leitura e interpretação de documentos técnicos (manuais, folhas de dados, desenhos e diagramas funcionais);
  • Fornecer suporte técnico às equipes operacionais;
  • Executar análise de falhas e definir estratégias de manutenção;
  • Elaborar e analisar especificações de materiais e estratégias de sobressalentes;
  • Desenvolver especificações técnicas para contratos.


Competências técnicas:


  • Experiência em manutenção de equipamentos dinâmicos;
  • Conhecimento em análise de falhas e estratégias de manutenção;
  • Vivência em suporte técnico a operações;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em SAP (módulos PM e MM);
  • Pacote MS Office em nível intermediário;
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentação técnica e elaboração de relatórios.


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência com bombas centrífugas de grande porte (acima de 1 MW);
  • Vivência com equipamentos de médio e grande porte na indústria de óleo e gás;
  • Atuação em ambiente offshore e/ou trabalho embarcado.


Formação:


  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica;
  • CREA ativo;
  • Experiência mínima de 8 anos como engenheiro, com registro em CTPS.
  • O que você pode esperar de nós?
  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche

description:
A Aldelia é uma multinacional franco-inglesa com foco em soluções de RH e terceirização de serviços. Atuante em diversos mercados, principalmente no setor de Óleo e Gás.

Pré-requisitos


  • Graduação concluída em Contabilidade, Finanças, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês avançado será diferencial.
  • Experiência prévia na área de contas a pagar, rotinas financeiras ou contabilidade.
  • Conhecimento básico dos processos de AP e do fluxo de fatura a pagamento.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas contábeis/ERP.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️



About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Network Automation Engineer
description:
Network Automation Engineer


We are looking for a Network Automation Engineer to design, build, and automate large-scale, carrier-grade network infrastructure. This role blends deep network engineering expertise with modern automation and software development practices. You will work on high-availability internet and backbone networks, translating complex network designs into repeatable, programmatic templates and workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain carrier-grade network infrastructure supporting internet and backbone services
  • Engineer and support Cisco IOS XR–based platforms in production environments
  • Develop and maintain network automation solutions using Python scripting
  • Translate network designs, configurations, and standards into programmatic templates (Jinja2)
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, validation, and lifecycle management of network devices
  • Design and support VPN architectures and products, including troubleshooting and optimisation
  • Ensure high availability, resiliency, and performance across large-scale networks
  • Participate in network design reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives


Required Skills & Experience

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, C#, .NET or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, C#, .NET or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a solid understanding of financial concepts and valuation methodologies.

• Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills to effectively convey complex ideas.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas através da participação ativa em Code Reviews e do desenvolvimento de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a Plataforma de Dados da Neoway;
  • Propor e criar ferramentas e pipelines de dados eficientes;
  • Manter e otimizar a plataforma de dados para ingestão, coleta e distribuição dos dados;
  • Fomentar e evoluir a cultura de engenharia de software no time;
  • Oferecer suporte e consultoria aos engenheiros de dados da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Python;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões de alta performance;
  • Demonstrar prudência e cuidado no gerenciamento de grandes volumes de dados;


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros.
  • Conhecer sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção à entrega e subsequente monitoramento;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento com seus pares;
  • Promover o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe;
  • Ter experienciado práticas com Code Review e Feedback;
  • Conhecimento avançado em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento na linguagem Golang;
  • Experiência na construção de APIs REST;
  • Experiência em execução de sistemas baseados em containers (Docker);
  • Experiência nos processos de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e/ou não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura e Cloud, de preferência GCP;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre Big Data, como por exemplo Datalake, catálogo de esquemas e metadados;


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Ter sido responsável por um projeto de ponta a ponta, incluindo desenvolvimento, deploy e monitoramento;

  • Expertise com governança de dados: qualidade, linhagem de dados e segurança;
  • Conhecimento avançado sobre Big Data e Plataformas de dados;

  • Experiência com Apache Iceberg
  • Ter trabalhado em time de plataforma na área de Big Data;
  • Desenvolvimento focado no usuário, desde a concepção até o feedback contínuo;

What you’ll do1. Service operations, on‑call & incidents
  • Design and maintain an on‑call and coverage plan that ensures all critical skills are available when needed (initially weekdays, evolving to full 24/7 where required).
  • Own the incident management process for your accounts: priorities, roles, communication cadence, escalations, and post‑incident reviews.
  • Define and monitor key service metrics (e.g., MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, backlog health) and drive improvements based on them.
  • Act as incident lead / coordinator during major incidents, keeping engineers focused and customers informed.


2. SOPs, runbooks & first‑line enablement
  • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, and triage guides for SRE engineers, covering common incident types and operational tasks.
  • Train and coach first‑line/SRE teams so they can confidently handle initial triage, basic troubleshooting, and clear communication , escalating only when needed.
  • Continuously refine documentation based on real incident experience and feedback.


3. Configuration management & readiness
  • Establish and run a configuration management process that keeps track of each customer’s environment (platforms in use, clusters, regions, configs, access, monitoring, key contacts).
  • Proactively close information gaps by working directly with customers and engineers.
  • Ensure configuration information is available and trustworthy during incidents and for onboarding new engineers.


4. Customer communication & governance
  • Be the primary operational contact for a set of enterprise customers.
  • Lead regular service reviews and status calls , presenting SLA performance, key incidents, risks, and improvement actions.
  • Present and agree on the incident management process with customers (channels, priorities, escalation paths, expectations).
  • Work closely with Account Management / Sales on renewals, expansions, and expectation management.


5. Commercial & delivery management
  • Clarify what is in scope vs. out of scope and work with customers and Sales to shape paid change requests when additional work is needed.
  • Monitor effort vs. contract , help protect margins, and flag risks early (under‑scoped contracts, chronic over‑use, under‑utilized capacity).
  • Work in a matrix environment , coordinating with different technical teams (e.g., database engineering, DevOps, SRE) to staff and deliver engagements effectively.


6. Onboarding & training
  • Design and maintain onboarding paths for new engineers joining support/delivery (shadowing, training on SOPs, environment overviews, “certification” on certain incident types).
  • Ensure new team members reach a productive, independent state quickly and safely.


What success looks like in 6–12 months
  • On‑call coverage is clear, predictable, and sustainable ; engineers know when they’re on and what’s expected.
  • First‑line/SREs handle a meaningful share of incidents without escalation , using well‑maintained runbooks.
  • You can open a customer’s configuration, see an accurate picture, and use it during incidents and planning.
  • SLA and incident metrics are tracked, reported, and discussed regularly with customers and internally.
  • Customers have a clear understanding of how incidents are handled and feel confident in the process.
  • New engineers ramp up faster thanks to structured onboarding and training.


You’ll be a great fit if you have
  • 5+ years in a Service Delivery, Managed Services, IT Operations, or Enterprise Support role serving external customers (not only internal IT).
  • Experience with 24/7 or extended‑hours operations , including on‑call or follow‑the‑sun setups.
  • Hands‑on experience with incident management and ITSM practices (incident/problem/change), ideally in an ITIL‑inspired environment.
  • A track record of creating or improving SOPs/runbooks and training first‑line / SRE teams.
  • Experience maintaining configuration / environment data for customer systems.
  • Comfort discussing technical topics with engineers (cloud, distributed systems, data platforms) and explaining them in clear business terms to customers.
  • Experience in commercial delivery : scope boundaries, change requests, effort vs. revenue, working alongside Sales / Account Management.
  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.


Nice to have

  • Background with data, analytics, or streaming platforms (e.g., Druid, Kafka, Flink, StarRocks, ClickHouse, TiDB, Hadoop, cloud data warehouses).
  • Experience working in small, fast‑moving, remote teams.


Location & working style
  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.
  • We are flexible on contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.

title: Investment Banking Jr. Associate
description:
2024 Atlas Technology Boutique Investment Bank of the Year and VentureBeat Top 5 Tech M&A Firm, Ignatious, is seeking top tier candidates to expand its global junior execution team.


Role Description


In this role, you will work directly with some of the most experienced and highly renowned bankers in the world’s most important and disruptive sector — technology — supporting and executing high-profile M&A and private capital raise transactions. You will be a key part of small client teams delivering the highest quality work product and outcomes to some of the most prominent technology companies in the world.  We are not a 9-to-5 firm, we work late hours and weekends.  If you are motivated, curious by nature and aspire to crush it in an ambitious setting next to other high performers seeking to build a world class investment bank, we want to hear from you.


This is a front-office position that is fully remote, and requires close collaboration with our U.S., Caribbean, LatAm, and other team members across the globe. The right candidate will have a relentless work ethic, strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for delivering precision work and unmatched client service in a high-pressure, entrepreneurial environment. 


Core Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English
  • +2 years of experience in front-office investment banking
  • Excellent analytical, financial modeling and critical thinking skills
  • Strong work ethic communication, presentation, problem-solving and negotiation skills
  • Strong PowerPoint Presentation skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with a track record of achieving goals
  • Bachelors and or/master's degree in an analytical field from a reputed college
  • Affinity for current events, critical issues, and relevant news


Job Responsibilities


Advanced Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Analyze and organize significant amounts of unstructured data to develop a coherent financial understanding of clients, the mechanics of their businesses and their historical performance 
  • Build from scratch and refine complex financial models (3-statement, DCF, LBO, accretion/dilution, etc.) to assess various capital structures, debt instruments, and valuation scenarios.
  • Develop strategic recommendations and support for creative transaction structures


Deal Execution Support

  • Collaborate directly with clients, advisors, and internal senior partners to provide regular updates on deal progress, outstanding issues, and strategic recommendations.
  • Coordinate due diligence processes (legal, financial, operational), monitoring timelines, and handling data flow among stakeholders.
  • Prepare transaction documentation including confidentiality agreements, term sheets, and final marketing materials for prospective investors or acquirers.


Pitchbook & Presentation Development

  • Craft high-impact pitch materials and management presentations, presenting complex financial data in an accessible and visually engaging format.
  • Continuously update standard client-facing materials with new market insights, recent transaction benchmarks, and emerging sector opportunities.


Market & Industry Research

  • Conduct in-depth industry analyses, monitoring key competitive trends, macroeconomic factors, and regulatory developments that may impact deal opportunities.


Mentorship & Team Coordination

  • Oversee and guide junior analysts in research, modeling best practices, and quality control, ensuring consistency and accuracy in all deliverables.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture by sharing knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and encouraging continuous learning.


Process Optimization & Best Practices

  • Evaluate current deal execution procedures, identifying process gaps and implementing improvements to streamline workflows.
  • Contribute to the creation and refinement of standardized templates, database resources, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to enhance team efficiency.


Compensation: 

  • Competitive Base Salary & Variable Compensation 
  • Significant Investment In Training, Mentorship and Professional Development 


Company Description

Specializing in M&A and private capital raise expertise, Ignatious helps technology companies achieve extraordinary financial outcomes in various verticals including AI/Artificial Intelligence (longstanding practice), Software, Mobility/Transportation, Consumer Internet, Health Care IT, FoodTech, AdTech/Marketing Tech, FinTech/Web 3.0, GovTech, and Prop Tech.


Ignatious is founded and led by Storm Duncan, former Global Head of Technology M&A at Credit Suisse and Jefferies. Storm has advised many of the most iconic companies and defining transactions in the technology sector including Google / YouTube / DoubleClick, Tencent / Universal Music Group, Microsoft, Apple / Drive.ai, Tinder / Match, Oracle / Sun / MySQL / RightNow, Uber / Careem, Lyft, AMD / NexGen, and AOL / DARPANET, amongst many others. His leadership is supported by a team of highly accomplished Senior Partners who previously led U.S. investment banking teams at J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, Deutsche Bank and Credit Suisse prior to joining Ignatious. 


If you are interested, please send CV to and / or apply on LinkedIn to ensure that you are considered for this role.

As an AI Engineer at Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company), you will join a team of talented AI engineers to implement and deploy AI-driven solutions across various industries. You will be responsible for developing AI strategies, ensuring the successful execution of AI projects, and contribute to the development of AI tools and platforms. You will work closely with clients to understand their business needs, review and implement AI solution designs, and ensure that Acora remains at the forefront of AI innovation.

AI Solution Design & Development :

Operational Excellence :

  • Be part of the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of AI solutions, ensuring they perform reliably at scale.
  • Develop frameworks and processes to ensure AI models are robust, explainable, and aligned with regulatory standards.


Key Skills & Experience:

  • English is a MUST.

  • Proficiency in Python, C#, Javascript.

Why Join Elastacloud?

  • Innovative Environment : Work on groundbreaking AI projects that have a real-world impact on industries such as security, finance, and energy. We pride ourselves on innovating through play and games, providing a safe environment to test many ideas and fail fast.
  • Leadership Opportunity : Shape the direction of AI innovation at Elastacloud and make a lasting impact on the business.

description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
VelorHealth is an established and rapidly scaling eCommerce brand operating in the 7–8 figure range. We are looking for a highly skilled Paid Social Video Ad Editor to join our creative performance team.


You will be responsible for editing high-performing ad creatives for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other paid channels. This role requires a strong understanding of direct response video editing , split-testing frameworks, and what drives conversions in DTC paid media.


We are not looking for a basic editor. We are looking for someone who understands how to build attention, maintain narrative tension, and convert cold audiences into buyers through video edits engineered for performance—not aesthetics alone.




Responsibilities


  • Edit short-form, performance-optimized video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Reels
  • Apply proven performance tactics: strong hooks, fast pacing, dynamic cuts, motion graphics, captions, and retention-driving structure
  • Work with raw UGC, product footage, AI-generated assets, voiceovers, and testimonials
  • Collaborate with creative strategists to interpret scripts, briefings, and messaging frameworks into final ads
  • Use AI video generation tools (Sora 2 or equivalent), plus editing software (Premiere, CapCut, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, etc.)
  • Test multiple creative variations designed for A/B performance testing
  • Continuously optimize edits based on data feedback—CTR, hold rate, thumb-stop ratio, CVR, CPA, etc.
  • Maintain brand consistency across dynamic performance creatives
  • Organize and maintain creative assets for versioning, split testing, and performance tracking




Requirements


  • Proven experience editing direct-response paid social ads (DTC experience strongly preferred)
  • Expertise in modern editing software and workflows
  • Experience leveraging AI creative tools including video, voiceover, motion, and script generation
  • Understanding of attention psychology: hooks, curiosity gaps, pattern interrupts, emotional pacing, and social proof stacking
  • Able to strategically incorporate on-screen text, captions, dynamic transitions, and brand elements to maximize watch time
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced direct-response environment with tight turnaround cycles
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating performance-driven ad editing




Bonus Qualifications


  • Prior experience working with 7–8 figure DTC brands
  • Experience editing UGC ads for Meta/TikTok
  • Familiarity with offer testing frameworks and CRO principles
  • Ability to analyze video performance metrics and iterate based on insights




Why This Role Matters


Every new VelorHealth ad you produce has the potential to reach millions. Your edits directly impact revenue, scale, and our mission to help people move freely, stay pain-free, and regain control of their mobility.


If you want to build high-performing ads for a fast-scaling DTC brand and leverage cutting-edge creative and AI technology, we’d love to meet you.

title: Full-Stack Developer / UI Designer
description:

polished, on-brand UI/UX in Figma. This role blends engineering, design, and AI-assised

title: Product Owner
description:
Procuramos um profissional talentoso e experiente para atuar como PMO (Project Management Officer) ou PO (Project Owner) em um projeto estratégico de Data Visualization de alta complexidade para nosso cliente. O projeto envolve a transformação de grandes volumes de dados em insights acionáveis através de dashboards e relatórios. O candidato deve ser fluente em inglês para gerenciar e colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, stakeholders e parceiros em nível global.

Responsabilidades Principais

Gestão de Projeto/Produto:

PMO Foco: Gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo do projeto, incluindo escopo, cronograma, orçamento, riscos e qualidade, garantindo que os objetivos estratégicos sejam alcançados dentro do prazo.

PO Foco: Definir, priorizar e manter o Product Backlog do projeto de DataViz, traduzindo as necessidades dos stakeholders e do cliente em histórias de usuário claras e critérios de aceitação.

Comunicação Global: Atuar como o principal ponto de contato, facilitando a comunicação clara e eficaz entre o cliente, stakeholders executivos e os times técnicos distribuídos globalmente.

Análise e Requisitos de Dados: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com analistas de dados e designers para refinar os requisitos de visualização, garantindo que os dashboards atendam às necessidades de informação e apresentem a narrativa correta.

Governança: Estabelecer e manter padrões, processos e métricas de desempenho (KPIs) para o projeto, garantindo a transparência e o alinhamento estratégico.

Mitigação de Riscos: Identificar proativamente riscos e impedimentos, desenvolvendo planos de mitigação e escalando problemas quando necessário.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência Comprovada: experiência atuando como PMO, Gerente de Projetos ou Product Owner em projetos de alta complexidade e grande escala.

Proficiência em Inglês: Fluência obrigatória (escrita e conversação) para comunicação diária com times e stakeholders internacionais.

Metodologias: Forte conhecimento e experiência prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e/ou tradicionais (PMBOK).

Data & DataViz: Sólida compreensão dos conceitos de Data Visualization, Business Intelligence (BI) e Storytelling com dados. Capacidade de entender a estrutura de dados e como ela suporta a visualização final.

Habilidades de Comunicação: Excelente habilidade de comunicação, negociação e gestão de conflitos, com experiência em interagir em nível executivo.

Conhecimentos Desejáveis (Um Diferencial)

Ferramentas de DataViz: Experiência prática com ferramentas líderes de mercado como Tableau, Power BI ou Looker Studio (Google Data Studio).

Certificações: Certificações relevantes (e.g., PMP, PSM/CSM, SAFe).

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento;
  • Plataforma exclusiva com treinamentos;
  • Programa de Desenvolvimento Profissional;
  • Ambiente de Trabalho Inovador;
  • Oportunidades de Crescimento na Organização;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.

No seu dia-a-dia :

  • Atuar nas atividades de pequena, média e alta complexidade para prospectar profissionais médicos, clinicas, através de visitas, apresentando vantagens e propostas de atração, visando o credenciamento para atendimento aos clientes, e aumento da utilização da rede credenciada;
  • Realizar a prospecção, implantação, manutenção e expansão da rede credenciada, analisando custos e garantindo a qualidade do serviço prestado, atuando com autonomia;
  • Descrever o processo de credenciamento de prestadores de serviço de atenção domiciliar, Retaguarda e Atenção Primária à Saúde, bem como elaborar relatórios e demonstrativos diversos da área, levantar e compilar dados, calcular e apurar valores, preenchendo
  • planilhas, visando disponibilizar informações gerenciais para a análise e tomada de decisão. Negociar com os novos credenciamentos a aplicação e padronização e referente as tabelas utilizadas pela companhia;
  • Realizar reuniões com as operadoras de serviço de atenção domiciliar para a análise de contratos, reajustes, aditivos de contratos, prestar suporte aos prestadores implantados, bem como orientar os novos prestadores sobre a rotina de faturamento, encaminhamentos e autorizações da operadora;
  • Monitorar o atendimento das cláusulas contratuais e índices da Agência Nacional da Saúde (ANS), através de reuniões para renegociações de reajustes e readequação de contratos;
  • Atender solicitações das Unimeds, direcionar as demandas às áreas pertinentes quando necessário, acompanhar e finalizar as resoluções;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as informações referentes ao negócio, bem como sobre projetos de expansão, legislação, concorrentes, clientes (operadora, médicos, clinicas, operadoras, etc.) e novas oportunidades;
  • Elaborar simulações de impacto financeiro com base nas solicitações de reajuste das Unimeds para renovação contratual;
  • Assessorar a Diretoria, a Superintendência, a Gerência nas demandas de relacionamento com
  • as Unimeds (custos, indicadores, reuniões). Parametrizar sistema interno com as regras contratuais e tabelas de pagamentos negociadas;
  • Manter constante contato com a área comercial, visando conhecer os novos negócios e ampliação dos atuais contratos, atuando proativamente na ampliação da rede de
  • credenciamento;
  • Pesquisar a abertura de novas unidades aos clientes, e/ou novos contratos em andamento e providenciar a rede credenciada necessária para atendimento, bem como manter a interface com a área de credenciamento para auxiliar no processo do credenciamento, e envio da documentação para credenciamento dos prestadores;
  • Verificar e analisar as cidades e municípios circunvizinhos, verificando a capacidade e disponibilidade de credenciamentos, visando o atendimento aos clientes e expansão nos negócios, e a partir desta análise elaborar credenciamento com as operadoras de serviço de atenção domiciliar.

  • Experiência com credenciamento de rede ambulatorial;

  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro/RJ;

Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso de uma empresa focada em cooperar e no seu cliente interno e externo.

title: Secretária
description:
SECRETÁRIA CRC | CLÍNICA ODONTOLÓGICA SORRISOS

REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓRIOS: EXPERIÊNCIA EM CLÍNICA MÉDICA OU ODONTOLÓGICA + RESIDIR NOS BAIRROS ESPECÍFICOS MENCIONADOS ABAIXO

QUEM SOMOS:

Em nossa clínica, transformamos vidas através de uma odontologia de excelência. Nossos valores fundamentais de honestidade, comprometimento, dedicação e qualidade guiam cada atendimento e procedimento que realizamos. Somos movidos pela missão de proporcionar saúde bucal de forma ética, humana e responsável, criando experiências únicas para nossos pacientes.

NOSSA VISÃO

Ser uma clínica referência em odontologia de excelência, proporcionando qualidade de vida e saúde bucal através de uma experiência única para nossos clientes. Aqui, cada paciente que chega com traumas e frustrações de experiências anteriores encontra acolhimento, profissionalismo e resultados transformadores.

A OPORTUNIDADE

Buscamos uma Secretária para nossa Central de Relacionamento com o Cliente (CRC) que compartilhe nossa paixão por transformar vidas e seja o primeiro sorriso acolhedor que nossos pacientes encontram ao chegar à clínica.

REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓRIOS:

• Experiência comprovada em clínicas odontológicas ou médicas • Residir OBRIGATORIAMENTE a no máximo 8 km da clínica (exemplo nos bairros: Realengo, Bangu, Campo Grande, Santa Cruz, Sepetiba ou Itaguaí) • Disponibilidade para início imediato

RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Primeiro Contato: Ser a voz e o rosto acolhedor da nossa clínica, recebendo pacientes com empatia e alegria • Gestão de Agenda: Organizar e otimizar os horários dos profissionais, confirmando consultas e evitando faltas • Comunicação Efetiva: Orientar pacientes sobre tratamentos e procedimentos com clareza e segurança • Organização Impecável: Manter prontuários, documentos e sistema atualizados para garantir processos eficientes • Suporte Administrativo: Auxiliar na parte administrativa da clínica, contribuindo para o fluxo de trabalho otimizado

O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS:

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita • Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas • Proatividade e resolução eficiente de problemas • Discrição e comprometimento com a confidencialidade • Habilidade com sistemas informatizados e pacote Office • Sorriso genuíno e capacidade de acolher pacientes mesmo em momentos de ansiedade

POR QUE SE JUNTAR A NÓS?

• Propósito Transformador: Fazer parte de histórias reais de transformação na vida das pessoas • Ambiente Inspirador: Trabalhar com uma equipe apaixonada e comprometida com a excelência • Desenvolvimento Profissional: Oportunidade de crescer com uma clínica em expansão • Cultura de Acolhimento: Ambiente que valoriza o bem-estar da equipe e dos pacientes

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

• Regime de Contratação: CLT • Local de Trabalho: CAMPO GRANDE.RJ • Horário: Segunda a sexta, horário comercial (disponibilidade para alguns sábados)

. Remuneração: R$ 2.000,00 + comissão e benefícios

COMO SE CANDIDATAR

Envie seu currículo para com o assunto "Secretária CRC - SORRISOS", destacando seu bairro de residência logo no início do e-mail.

IMPORTANTE: Currículos sem a informação do bairro de residência ou de candidatas residentes fora das áreas mencionadas não serão avaliados.
